errors.log_timeout: Log timeout. Check the operation report.

errors.shutdown_timeout: Shutdown timeout. Check the operation report.

errors.storage_failed: Cannot save or read data. Check free space and permissions.
errors.submission_unknown: Submission unknown. Check the operation report.
errors.unsupported_image: Unsupported image. Check the operation report.
errors.unsupported_asset: This model cannot be prepared automatically. Use a public Hugging Face or Civitai safetensors file with a verified SHA256 and installed standard nodes.
errors.extension_unavailable: Workflow preparation requires the Komaquill extension on the connected ComfyUI server. Standard generation and collection remain available.
errors.invalid_evaluation: Invalid evaluation. Check the referenced runs, evaluation mode and reviewer provenance.
errors.real_llm_not_allowed: Generation is not ready. Check Settings and try again.
errors.llm_dependencies_missing: Story model dependencies are unavailable. Install komaquill[llm] or run bootstrap/setup.ps1.
errors.llm_unavailable: The language model request failed. Check the selected model, endpoint, timeout and API compatibility. No fallback model was used.
errors.llm_request_invalid: The selected language model rejected the request format. Check the model profile and API compatibility before trying again.
errors.story_plan_invalid: The model did not return a valid complete story plan. Inspect the saved planning attempts and revise the input or model settings.
errors.fake_story_mismatch: The fake profile only supports the packaged rainy-cat sample and supported image counts. Use that sample or explicitly enable a real model.
errors.invalid_story_count: Image count is outside the configured range. Check --images and story.max_images.
errors.image_backend_unavailable: An image GPU is not available. Start a prepared image session before generating a story. Planning alone does not need an image GPU.
errors.migration_required: Workspace storage requires migration. Stop the session and run komaquill migrate.
errors.story_replan_required: This plan has no frozen structured image inputs. Plan its saved source.txt again before rendering; existing images and history are retained.
errors.unsupported_batch: This preset has no declared candidate output and batch binding. Add them or omit --candidates.
errors.preparation_timeout: Model preparation reached its deadline. Check preparation status and stop the owned runtime before trying again.
errors.operation_busy: Another reply or draft is being created. Wait for it to finish.
errors.operation_conflict: This item has changed. Reload its saved version before continuing.
errors.fake_input_mismatch: This content could not be generated. Check the connection in Settings.
errors.context_limit_exceeded: The conversation context exceeds the input limit. Shorten the scenario, state, or message, or adjust the conversation input limit.
